intent: 按数仓分层统计本期与上一等长周期的新增建表数，并计算环比增长率
caliber: 口径字段为 data_table.created_at；只统计 deleted = 0 的表；上期区间与本期等长且不重叠；上期为 0 的分层不参与环比计算，会被剔除。
notes: 对应论文 HeadcountGrowth 结构：previous 依赖 current 并把它返回的分层拼进 IN 列表；current 同时被 previous 与 growth 依赖，引擎只执行一次。

params.name: days
params.description: 本期天数；上期取紧邻的等长区间

params.name: layer
params.description: 只看某一个数仓分层；不传则覆盖全部分层

current.description: 本期各分层新增建表数
current.sql:
SELECT layer, COUNT(id) AS table_cnt
FROM opendataworks.data_table
WHERE deleted = 0
  AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL {{ params.days }} DAY)
  {{? layer_filter }}
GROUP BY layer

previous.description: 上一等长周期各分层新增建表数，范围收敛到本期出现过的分层
previous.sql:
SELECT layer, COUNT(id) AS table_cnt
FROM opendataworks.data_table
WHERE deleted = 0
  AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL {{ params.days * 2 }} DAY)
  AND created_at < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL {{ params.days }} DAY)
  {{? layer_scope }}
GROUP BY layer

growth.description: 内存 join 两期结果并计算环比增长率
growth.sql:
SELECT c.layer AS layer,
       c.table_cnt AS current_cnt,
       p.table_cnt AS previous_cnt,
       CAST(c.table_cnt - p.table_cnt AS REAL) / p.table_cnt AS growth
FROM current c
INNER JOIN previous p ON c.layer = p.layer
WHERE p.table_cnt > 0
ORDER BY growth DESC
